description: Which expressions built around aggregates over GA are accepted, with which result type and value or error number: Sum/Count and Sum\Count, Sum(v + 1) beside Sum(v) + 1, Sum of an IIf, IIf over a Sum, Sum & '', unary minus and Abs of a Sum, Sum times a fraction, Sum Mod 2, the same aggregate twice (distinct aliases and the same alias), Sum(Sum(v)), Max(Count(*)) with GROUP BY, the same through a derived table, Sum(v) / Sum(d), Avg(v * 2), Sum(CDbl(v)) and Sum(Nz(v, 0))? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
